where: Inverkip Rd roundabout by Lady Alice Primary School
rule: Coming down Inverkip Rd from the Morrisons Daily end, stay in the left lane on the approach, even when turning right towards Lady Alice Primary School.

where: Greenock Rd double roundabout by B&Q, Port Glasgow
rule: If told to take the third exit at the second roundabout (by Lithgow Way), approach the first roundabout in the right lane.
why: So you don't have to change lanes between the two roundabouts.

where: Scott Way junction by Chalmers Ln, near Bogston
rule: Open junction: if the road on your right is empty, you don't need to stop before turning left.
